_help: Template for own corridor clips. Copy an entry into val.json OR test.json, replace every <...>, and delete the _help keys. One recording session and one camera position belong to ONE split. See docs/RECORDING_GUIDE.md and configs/manifests/README.md.

clips._help: An ordinary clip, every frame annotated (no annotated_frames key).
clips.license: own footage, written consent on file (<consent record id>)

clips._help: A negative clip: people visible, nobody enters the corridor. events.json is [].
clips.license: own footage, written consent on file (<consent record id>)

clips._help: A sparsely annotated clip (e.g. every 10th frame, from import-cvat). Only those frames are scored; hand-labelled gt_events are required.
clips.license: own footage, written consent on file (<consent record id>)
